text:
Oh no, I'm so sorry, that must be really scary. Please do this right now:

- **Contact your vet or your local poison control immediately.** Don't wait for symptoms to show up. Tell them your cat chewed a pothos leaf, roughly how much was eaten, and when it happened.
- If you can, take a photo of the plant and keep the plant's name handy so they can advise you quickly.
- Follow their instructions closely, including whether your cat needs to be seen in person.

I'm escalating this to a Support Lead now as a safety issue. I can't give medical advice myself, so your vet or poison control is the best first call. Please go ahead and contact them first, and don't worry about replying here until your cat has been looked after.

For the escalation, it would help to know:
- Your Leafy order number (it looks like LF- followed by six digits), if the pothos came from us

A Support Lead will follow up with you. Our chat is open 8am-8pm Mon-Sat, and email at help@leafy.example is answered within 1 business day. I don't have an exact time for when the Support Lead will reach out, so please don't wait on us before getting help for your cat.

I'm thinking of you and your cat, and I hope they're okay. Please reach out any time you need us. 🌿
